# Configuration
{: .no_toc }

What production is actually running with.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

This screen is part of the **web Hub's Console** and isn't in the Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS or Android apps yet (specs OPEN-QUESTIONS #27).
{: .note }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `CFG-01` |
| **Route** | `/ops/config` |
| **Where** | Operations › Configuration |
| **Who can use it** | operations.view |
| **Kind** | settings |
| **Available in** | Web Hub only (Console M3 (web only)) |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| Per function | key-value groups | non-secret settings from an allow-list: URLs, CORS origins, backends, log level | secrets never leave the gateway |
| Policy | key-value | rate-limit defaults, token lifetimes, password policy, API version served | each with its source (Terraform variable or code constant) |

## Good to know

- Read-only. Terraform-owned values say "Change this in the API repo" and link to the variable.

## For developers

Loads: `GET /ops/config`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
